answer: An information-theoretic defense for Sybil resistance among autonomous agents anchors its atlas of trust in recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments composed with verifiable delay primitives, whose sequential work binds each identity to a unique temporal kernel so that cloning incurs unavoidable entropy accumulation.
